Manipal Hospital Expands South Bangalore Healthcare Services

Manipal Hospital's Kanakapura Road facility has expanded its healthcare services in South Bangalore, introducing a comprehensive '360° Gut Care' program. This initiative aims to provide a broader footprint in the region's healthcare landscape. The hospital is emphasizing its commitment to advanced patient care and specialized medical services.
